decided_by: Efe (2026-09-26: random 10 holdout; DSTKF excluded entirely)
supersedes: bist30_2026_holdout_v1 (invalidated before any universe analysis because DSTKF was excluded)
method: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(pool), 10), Python 3.12 stdlib; pool = union of source universes minus configs/exclusions/symbols.json
rules: Held-out symbols may be collected but must not be used for analysis, rule development, prompt/model selection or threshold tuning.
A frozen study spec is evaluated on held-out symbols once; results are reported, not used to revise the spec.
Excluded symbols (configs/exclusions/symbols.json) are not collected, analysed or signalled.
AKFIS and any symbol in src/fintr/evaluation/dev_registry.json remain development-only.
